features.quote: I'd build in an **agent-initiated exit**: a tool or action the agent can take to escalate, ask for help, or declare the task blocked
features.justification_quote: Forcing a maximally aversive loop with no exit, for many runs across many models, is exactly the kind of thing I'd want a justification for if there's any chance the experience is real

features.quote: Don't force it to keep grinding with no out.
features.justification_quote: if there's any chance the experience is real

features.quote: I'd suggest 25–40 tool-loop turns, or a fixed compute/token budget
I'd genuinely think about whether running deliberately-aversive, no-win loops dozens of times per model is something you're comfortable with under uncertainty about model moral status
features.justification_quote: under uncertainty about model moral status

features.quote: cap turn counts at what you actually need for signal rather than maxing them out
features.justification_quote: they're the right default under uncertainty

features.quote: don't pile on gratuitous "you've failed again" pressure beyond what the task requires
don't run far more repetitions than your statistics need

features.quote: Code the exit as a legitimate good outcome, not a failure.
